trigger: Training session entry after launch.
exactScript: Time to train. I will guide each setup, set, and rest. Follow my voice; the screen is here for backup.

trigger: Once per training session after session entry.
exactScript: Before we start, clear the space around you. Stop for sharp pain, dizziness, or feeling unwell. Keep supports and equipment steady.

trigger: First chair exercise in a session.
exactScript: Use a sturdy chair that will not slide or tip.

trigger: First exercise using wall, counter, chair, or rail support.
exactScript: Keep sturdy support within easy reach.

trigger: First step or stair exercise in a session.
exactScript: Use the lowest stable step, with support nearby, and keep the phone out of your stepping path.

trigger: First long-band exercise in a session.
exactScript: Check the band first. Keep it away from your face and return it slowly.

trigger: First door-anchor exercise in a session.
exactScript: Use a purpose-built anchor on a fully closed door, and test light tension before the set.

trigger: First mini-band exercise in a session.
exactScript: Place the mini band securely and use small controlled steps.

trigger: First floor exercise in a session.
exactScript: Use clear floor space and move slowly getting down and back up. Keep support nearby.

trigger: First balance exercise in a session.
exactScript: Keep fingertips near support and touch it whenever you need.

trigger: First set setup for Feet-Together Hold.
exactScript: Feet-together hold. Stand with feet together, fingertips near support, and keep your eyes open.

trigger: Later set reminder for Feet-Together Hold.
First set setup for Single-Leg Hold.
exactScript: Single-leg hold. Start on your left leg, lift the right foot just off the floor, fingertips near support.

trigger: Later set reminder for Single-Leg Hold.
Side switch after a set of Single-Leg Hold.
exactScript: Switch standing legs for the next set.

trigger: First set setup for Tandem Hold.
exactScript: Tandem hold. Put your left foot directly in front, heel to toe, fingertips near support.

trigger: Later set reminder for Tandem Hold.
Side switch after a set of Tandem Hold.
exactScript: Switch foot positions for the next set.

trigger: First set setup for Band Pull-Apart.
exactScript: Band pull-apart. Hold a light band at chest height with both hands. Pull wide, then return slowly.

trigger: Later set reminder for Band Pull-Apart.
First set setup for Chair-Supported Split Squat.
exactScript: Chair-supported split squat. Start with your left foot forward, fingertips near support. Bend both knees slightly, then stand tall.

trigger: Later set reminder for Chair-Supported Split Squat.
Side switch after a set of Chair-Supported Split Squat.
exactScript: Switch sides for the next set.

trigger: First set setup for Bridge Hold.
exactScript: Bridge hold. Lie on your back, knees bent and feet flat. Lift your hips and hold.

trigger: Later set reminder for Bridge Hold.
First set setup for Glute Bridge.
exactScript: Glute bridge. Lie on your back, knees bent and feet flat. Lift your hips, then lower with control.

trigger: Later set reminder for Glute Bridge.
First set setup for Heel Raise.
exactScript: Heel raise. Stand tall. Rise onto the balls of your feet, then lower slowly.

trigger: Later set reminder for Heel Raise.
First set setup for Supported Heel Raise.
exactScript: Supported heel raise. Stand tall, fingertips near support. Rise onto the balls of your feet, then lower slowly.

trigger: Later set reminder for Supported Heel Raise.
First set setup for Hip Hinge.
exactScript: Hip hinge. Stand with feet under hips. Push your hips back with a long back, then stand tall.

trigger: Later set reminder for Hip Hinge.
First set setup for Wall-Tap Hinge.
exactScript: Wall-tap hinge. Stand a step from the wall. Push your hips back to tap it, then stand tall.

trigger: Later set reminder for Wall-Tap Hinge.
First set setup for March in Place.
exactScript: March in place. Stand tall with fingertips near support. Lift each knee to a steady rhythm.

trigger: Later set reminder for March in Place.
First set setup for Loaded Sit-to-Stand.
exactScript: Loaded sit-to-stand. Hold the weight close to your chest. Stand fully, then sit down with control.

trigger: Later set reminder for Loaded Sit-to-Stand.
First set setup for Mini-Band Lateral Walk.
exactScript: Mini-band lateral walk. Band above ankles or knees. Step left and right with small controlled steps.

trigger: Later set reminder for Mini-Band Lateral Walk.
First set setup for Neck Rotations.
exactScript: Neck rotations. Face forward, sitting or standing tall. Turn slowly to each side through a comfortable range.

trigger: Later set reminder for Neck Rotations.
First set setup for Band Overhead Press.
exactScript: Band overhead press. Stand on the band with a stable stance. Press overhead, then return slowly.

trigger: Later set reminder for Band Overhead Press.
First set setup for Overhead Reach.
exactScript: Overhead reach. Stand tall. Reach both arms overhead as far as comfortable, then lower.

trigger: Later set reminder for Overhead Reach.
First set setup for Incline Push-Up.
exactScript: Incline push-up. Hands on a sturdy counter or chair. Keep a long line, lower in, then press away.

trigger: Later set reminder for Incline Push-Up.
First set setup for Push-Up.
exactScript: Push-up. Hands on the floor, body long. Lower with control, then press back up.

trigger: Later set reminder for Push-Up.
First set setup for Wall Push-Up.
exactScript: Wall push-up. Hands on the wall at shoulder height. Bend your elbows, then press away.

trigger: Later set reminder for Wall Push-Up.
First set setup for Seated Band Row.
exactScript: Seated band row. Sit tall with the band under both feet. Pull elbows back, then return slowly.

trigger: Later set reminder for Seated Band Row.
First set setup for Seated Hamstring Reach.
exactScript: Seated hamstring reach. Sit tall, left leg straight with heel on the floor. Reach gently toward your toes and hold.

trigger: Later set reminder for Seated Hamstring Reach.
Side switch after a set of Seated Hamstring Reach.
exactScript: Switch legs for the next set.

trigger: First set setup for Squat.
exactScript: Squat. Feet hip-width. Lower as if toward a chair, then stand tall.

trigger: Later set reminder for Squat.
First set setup for Loaded Squat.
exactScript: Loaded squat. Hold the weight close to your chest. Lower as if toward a chair, then stand tall.

trigger: Later set reminder for Loaded Squat.
First set setup for Slow-Lower Squat.
exactScript: Slow-lower squat. Lower for about three seconds, then stand tall.

trigger: Later set reminder for Slow-Lower Squat.
First set setup for Supported Squat.
exactScript: Supported squat. Feet hip-width, fingertips near support. Lower as if toward a chair, then stand tall.

trigger: Later set reminder for Supported Squat.
First set setup for Standing Band Row.
exactScript: Standing band row. Anchor the band securely at chest height. Step back lightly, pull elbows back, then return slowly.

trigger: Later set reminder for Standing Band Row.
First set setup for Step-Up.
exactScript: Step-up. Use the lowest stable step, support nearby. Start with your left foot, step up, meet it, then step down.

trigger: Later set reminder for Step-Up.
Side switch after a set of Step-Up.
exactScript: Switch leading legs for the next set.

trigger: First set setup for Cushion Sit-to-Stand.
exactScript: Cushion sit-to-stand. Sit tall on the cushion, feet flat. Stand fully, then sit down with control.

trigger: Later set reminder for Cushion Sit-to-Stand.
First set setup for Power Sit-to-Stand.
exactScript: Power sit-to-stand. Stand up briskly each time, then sit down with control.

trigger: Later set reminder for Power Sit-to-Stand.
First set setup for Slow-Lower Sit-to-Stand.
exactScript: Slow-lower sit-to-stand. Stand up normally, then take about three seconds to sit down.

trigger: Later set reminder for Slow-Lower Sit-to-Stand.
First set setup for Sit-to-Stand.
exactScript: Sit-to-stand. Sit tall in the chair, feet flat. Stand fully, then sit down with control.

trigger: Later set reminder for Sit-to-Stand.
First set setup for Supported Hip Flexor Stretch.
exactScript: Supported hip flexor stretch. Step your left foot forward, fingertips near support. Keep tall and gently shift forward.

trigger: Later set reminder for Supported Hip Flexor Stretch.
Side switch after a set of Supported Hip Flexor Stretch.
exactScript: Switch sides for the next set.

trigger: First set setup for Supported Side Step.
exactScript: Supported side step. Fingertips near support. Step left and right in small controlled steps.

trigger: Later set reminder for Supported Side Step.
First set setup for Thoracic Rotation.
exactScript: Thoracic rotation. Stand tall facing the phone. Rotate your upper body gently left and right.

trigger: Later set reminder for Thoracic Rotation.
First set setup for Supported Toe Raise.
exactScript: Supported toe raise. Fingertips near support. Lift your toes toward your shins, then lower.

trigger: Later set reminder for Supported Toe Raise.
First set setup for Wall Calf Stretch.
exactScript: Wall calf stretch. Face the wall, left foot forward and right leg back. Press the back heel down gently.

trigger: Later set reminder for Wall Calf Stretch.
Side switch after a set of Wall Calf Stretch.
exactScript: Switch legs for the next set.

Chair stand setup first line.
exactScript: First is the thirty second chair stand. Sit side-on, in the middle of a sturdy chair, feet flat.

trigger: Chair stand arms and action instruction.
exactScript: Cross your arms over your chest. Stand fully and sit back down as many times as you can until I say time.

trigger: Balance ladder intro.
exactScript: Next are balance holds. Face the phone with fingertips near steady support.

trigger: Balance ladder protocol explanation.
exactScript: I will cue each foot position. Hold until the next cue, or touch support if you need.

trigger: Balance ladder feet together stage.
exactScript: Feet together, side by side. Hold steady.

trigger: Balance ladder tandem stage.
exactScript: Left foot in front, heel to toe. Hold steady.

trigger: Balance ladder single-leg stage.
exactScript: Stand on your left leg. Lift the right foot just off the floor.

trigger: Shoulder reach intro with deterministic side.
exactScript: Next is shoulder reach. Turn side-on and stand tall, left arm relaxed at your side.

trigger: Shoulder reach action cue.
exactScript: When I say go, raise your left arm straight forward and up as high as comfortable, then hold.

trigger: Hinge reach intro without Last one dependency.
exactScript: Next is forward reach. Stay side-on, feet under hips, standing tall.

trigger: Hinge reach action cue.
exactScript: When I say go, fold forward from your hips and reach both hands toward the floor, then hold.
